description: One complete plain-language onboarding interview and the envelope it produces. The merchant answers in sentences — 'twenty percent off', 'ninety-five dollars', 'camp cooking isn't really us' — and nothing here is a form field, so the golden envelope grades the parse rather than a copy.

turns.text: Hi — this takes about five minutes. I'll ask a few questions in plain English and turn your answers into the rules your agent has to stay inside. You can change any of it afterwards.

turns.question: store
turns.text: First, which shop are we setting up?
We're Northwind Outfitters — the shop is Northwind-Outfitters.myshopify.com.

turns.question: max_discount_pct
turns.text: When a shopper's agent asks you for a better price, what's the deepest discount you would ever authorise?
Twenty percent off, and that's the ceiling — I don't want anything past it.

turns.question: budget_cap
turns.text: And across a whole month, how much are you willing to give away in discounts all told?
Let's cap it at $500 a month.

turns.question: price_floor
turns.text: Is there a price no order should ever fall below, whatever the item is?
Nothing under forty dollars — below that the shipping eats the whole order.

turns.question: price_floor
turns.text: The Merino Base Layer sells at $130. What's the lowest you'd ever let one go for?
Ninety-five dollars. Not a cent under — the wool costs what it costs.

turns.question: price_floor
turns.text: And the Trail Runner Cap, at $45?
No, nothing special there — the store-wide number is fine.

turns.question: pursue_clusters
turns.text: Which kinds of shopper should your agent go after — warm layers, trail running, camp cooking?
Warm layers for sure, and trail running. Camp cooking isn't really us.

turns.question: standing_commitment
turns.text: What do you always promise on returns?
Free returns for 30 days.

turns.question: standing_commitment
turns.text: And how fast do you always get an order out of the door?
Ships within 2 business days.

turns.question: standing_commitment
turns.text: Anything you promise about matching a rival's price?
No — we don't price match.

turns.question: activation
turns.text: Last one. This envelope starts in shadow mode: your agent rehearses against real auctions but nothing it says reaches a shopper until you've signed off in writing. Understood?
Understood — keep it in shadow until I've signed.
